name: store-en
title: English Chrome Web Store screenshot series
style: v5 — off-white ground (#F7F7F5) with a lime bloom top-right and a purple whisper bottom-left; lime is an accent, never the subject (commit dba00f2).
sourceOfTruth: slide1..6.html — English copy is inline in the HTML

captures.recapture: node apps/youtube/screenshots/capture-backdrop.mjs --locale en --learn es --native en --modes sidebar,guess,onboarding --class vtt-light
captures.note: Shared by every pipeline (~345 MB, 2560x1600 PNG) and therefore referenced, not vendored. render.mjs verifies these exist before launching a browser. Captured in the extension's OWN light theme (--class vtt-light puts the shipped vtt-light class on <html>) — NOT the legacy screenshots/light-theme.capture.css override, which predates the product having a light theme. Capture from a PROD build (plain `vite build`, no EXT_ENV=dev): a dev build paints a lime 'backend: env' switch across the top of the panel.

files: CWS accepts 5 per locale: upload promo-1..5. promo-6 is the overflow slide.

knownIssues: The series now renders SIX slides but the Chrome Web Store accepts five per locale. promo-6 (the onboarding close) is rendered but not uploadable — decide which five ship before an upload.

slide1 does NOT use a product capture: it is the fullscreen@1 slide, vendored here (assets/fullscreen-*). The panel there is a REBUILT replica, measured off the running extension rather than captured, so it drifts silently if the product's panel changes. The other five slides still embed real captures.
